title: Jelly Like Russian Beef Dumplings
description: A traditional Russian dish featuring fatty and glassy-jelly like dumplings, made with five spice powder and served in a Korean brass bowl, this recipe is kid-friendly and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground beef, chopped onion, five spice powder, salt, and black pepper, and mix until just combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and egg.
Add the flour mixture to the beef mixture, and mix until a sticky dough forms.
Gradually add the water to the dough, and mix until the dough comes together and is smooth.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes, until it is elastic and shiny.
Divide the dough into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil, and cook the dumplings for 10-15 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon, and serve in a Korean brass bowl.
To achieve the jelly-like texture, cook the dumplings in the water for an additional 5 minutes, then remove and let cool.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
